title: SS1 earn Superleague title
description: SS1 - Ceadir-Lunga 111-77 SS1 have been crowned Superleague champions. They crushed Ceadir-Lunga 111-77 in the third game of the championship series to complete the sweep. Vitali Golodniy (195-F-1985) posted 24 points, 11 rebounds and 8 assists to lead the champions. SS1 went on a massive 61-33 second half run to ice the win. Vadim Bychkov (203-C-1999) delivered 23 points in the victory. Alexandr Guboglo answered with 21 points and 9 assists for Ceadir-Lunga.
